threat_event: Cross-division PHI exposure or misuse on the Group Data Platform
threat_source: Insider or external attacker; process failure
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Mixed Care Delivery and Health Plan PHI; inconsistent purpose-based access; minimum necessary between divisions not verified; identifiable SaaS data in staging
likelihood_basis: EV-025 (mixed zones; tags on 61% of tables); EV-027 (standing roles in both covered-entity zones); EV-028 (no minimum-necessary protocol per feed); EV-026 (identifiable SaaS data in staging)
existing_controls: Role-based access; quarterly certification; group SOC monitoring
treatment_plan: Zone separation by covered entity; attribute-based purpose tags; minimum-necessary protocols for routine feeds; de-identify before landing

threat_event: Ransomware spreads through shared services and exfiltrates data from several divisions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared identity, network, and data platform connect all divisions; legacy segments at Care Delivery and Health Plan
likelihood_basis: EV-020 (shared hub network); EV-046 (flat management network at 23 legacy sites); EV-061 (claims core restore tested once a year); EV-082 (group risk interviews)
treatment_plan: Complete legacy segmentation; quarterly restore tests; cross-division tabletop (P08)

threat_event: A shared-service incident misses one or more regulator, customer, or investor notice deadlines
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single notification matrix not exercised; each covered entity and the SaaS have different clocks
likelihood_basis: EV-031 (draft notification matrix, not exercised); EV-068 (customer BAA notice terms vary)
treatment_plan: Adopt the multi-regulator matrix (P08); cross-division tabletop by 2026-12-15

threat_event: AI systems in regulated decisions or products operate without adequate governance and evidence
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Group AI standard new in 2026; UM model review documentation incomplete; SaaS AI launched without commitment updates
likelihood_basis: EV-041 (AI in use; no AI standard at intake); EV-063 (UM model not before the UM committee); EV-071 (AI feature released without privacy analysis)
existing_controls: Group AI standard; AI use-case inventory
treatment_plan: Group AI governance program (P10): inventory, tiering, pre-deployment review, monitoring

threat_event: Division policy supplements drift from group policy
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Health Plan standards last aligned in 2024; no drift check
likelihood_basis: EV-016 (supplement versions; no drift check); EV-059 (Health Plan standards aligned 2024-03)
treatment_plan: Annual supplement alignment attestation by each division

threat_event: Common control inheritance is unverified for a division, so gaps go unowned
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Inheritance documented for Care Delivery and SaaS but not the Health Plan
likelihood_basis: EV-017 (no Health Plan inheritance matrix); EV-060 (2025 Health Plan assessment scope)
treatment_plan: Health Plan inheritance matrix; annual confirmation by division leads

threat_event: Compromise of the group identity platform gives access across all divisions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single identity platform for 45,000 users
likelihood_basis: EV-005 (one identity platform for 45,000 users; MFA settings); EV-007 (PAM elevation)
existing_controls: Phishing-resistant MFA for administrators; PAM; tiered admin model
treatment_plan: Phishing-resistant MFA for all remote access by 2027-06-30

threat_event: Critical third-party outage or breach disrupts care or claims across divisions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Concentration on single clearinghouse and delegated vendors
likelihood_basis: EV-052 (85% of claims through one clearinghouse); EV-065 (14 delegated vendors reviewed yearly); EV-039 (tiered vendor program)
existing_controls: Tiered vendor program; BAAs; SOC 2 reviews
treatment_plan: Second clearinghouse; continuous monitoring of tier 1 vendors

threat_event: Cloud region outage on the group platform affects several divisions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Some Care Delivery and Health Plan workloads single-region
likelihood_basis: EV-018 (single-region workloads)
existing_controls: Multi-zone design; DR replica on provider B
treatment_plan: Multi-region for tier 1 workloads

threat_event: Materiality of a cybersecurity incident is not determined and disclosed on time
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Materiality criteria for multi-division incidents not documented
likelihood_basis: EV-032 (no written materiality criteria for multi-division incidents)
regulatory_driver: N52-R08 / N51-R08 (Form 8-K Item 1.05; Reg S-K Item 106)
treatment_plan: Documented materiality criteria and escalation within 24 hours of a Severity 1 incident

threat_event: Insider misuse of PHI across divisions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Monitoring coverage differs by division
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-D1; SYS-D2; SYS-D3; Group Data Platform
likelihood_basis: EV-048 (EHR privacy monitoring); EV-062 (care management notes not monitored); EV-074 (support record search without a ticket)
treatment_plan: Common insider-risk analytics in the group SIEM

threat_event: Division systems outside group monitoring hide an intrusion
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Legacy EHR at acquired practices and claims middleware not onboarded to the SIEM
likelihood_basis: EV-010 (legacy EHR and claims middleware not in the SIEM source list)
treatment_plan: Onboard all ePHI systems to the SIEM by 2026-12-31

threat_event: Medical device and vendor remote access used as an entry point
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Unsupported device operating systems; persistent vendor tunnels
likelihood_basis: EV-045 (41 unsupported devices); EV-051 (persistent imaging vendor tunnels)
treatment_plan: Complete segmentation; vendor access through PAM

threat_event: Regional hurricane affects several divisions at once
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Southeastern concentration of sites and staff
likelihood_basis: EV-045 (southeastern site footprint); EV-067 (coastal claims center); EV-082 (group risk interviews)
treatment_plan: Group crisis management exercise before hurricane season

threat_event: Account takeover on consumer, broker, and customer-facing platforms
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MFA optional for patients and members; SMS codes for brokers; customer-controlled MFA in SaaS
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-D4; member and broker portals; SYS-D3
likelihood_basis: EV-056 (patient MFA optional); EV-064 (member MFA optional; broker SMS codes); EV-069 (customer-controlled MFA)
treatment_plan: Group external identity standard with risk-based MFA

threat_event: Assurance commitments to customers are not met (SOC 2 exceptions or qualified opinion)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SaaS system description outdated; patient-app platform has no report yet
likelihood_basis: EV-069 (system description predates the AI feature); EV-056 (no report for the patient-app platform)
treatment_plan: Update system description before the period ends; patient-app readiness (P09)

threat_event: Business associate agreements do not match current data flows
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Health Plan intercompany BAA predates the Group Data Platform; 97 SaaS BAAs silent on de-identification
likelihood_basis: EV-004 (2019 Health Plan intercompany BAA); EV-068 (97 BAAs silent on de-identification)
treatment_plan: Re-paper the Health Plan intercompany BAA; amend SaaS BAAs at renewal

threat_event: Clinical and coverage algorithms discriminate by age, sex, race, or disability
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Tool inventories incomplete; subgroup monitoring not in place
likelihood_basis: EV-057 (decision support inventory lists EHR tools only; age and sex inputs); EV-063 (no subgroup monitoring)
existing_controls: Clinical decision support committee; UM committee
treatment_plan: Group fairness testing standard (P10)

threat_event: Software supply chain compromise in group-built applications
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Pipeline credentials long-lived; exception handling informal
likelihood_basis: EV-073 (long-lived pipeline secrets); EV-056 (scan exceptions not time-limited)
treatment_plan: Group secure build standard

threat_event: Group Data Platform outage delays quality reporting and risk adjustment submissions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Batch reporting deadlines; DR replica tested annually
likelihood_basis: EV-030 (DR replica tested annually)
treatment_plan: Semiannual DR test of the platform

threat_event: Security documentation is not retained for six years across divisions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Division records schedules differ
likelihood_basis: EV-043 (division retention schedules differ)
treatment_plan: One group retention schedule for security records
